input.title: Women's Christmas – French Bulldog Santa's Cookies? What Cookies. Tee
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

Santa's cookies? What cookies. A French Bulldog tee for the Frenchie mom whose dog cleaned the plate before Santa landed and now sits there looking innocent. Wear it to the tree, the cookie swap or the Christmas Eve plate-and-milk setup, and let the crumbs do the talking.

The art is a 1950s Christmas-card scene: a fawn French Bulldog with a dark mask and big upright bat ears, in a small red Santa hat pushed to one side, sits very upright with crumbs stuck to its muzzle and chest and its eyes glancing away. Beside it are an empty cracked plate with a few crumbs, a tipped glass with a small white puddle of milk, a candy cane, a blank note card and a few pine needles. SANTA'S COOKIES? runs across the top in heavy deep-red capitals and WHAT COOKIES. stacks across the bottom in pine green; on the dark shirts they turn cream and mustard, and the scene gets a cream outline.

It makes an easy gift for the Frenchie owner who has already lost a cookie, from a partner, a sister or the dog walker, and it suits a frenchie christmas morning. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: White, Natural, Pink, Heather Stone, Black, Navy, Maroon, Forest Green
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

How does the Santa's Cookies? What Cookies. tee fit?
The Santa's Cookies? What Cookies. tee from Graphic Tees Co. is a Bella+Canvas 6400 relaxed women's cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy fit or go up one for an oversized, cozy look. Compare the size chart with a tee you already own, and the first exchange is free.

What is it made of and how do I wash it?
It is 100% combed, ring-spun cotton at a lightweight 4.2 oz/yd², pre-shrunk with side seams; the heather colors contain polyester. Turn the Graphic Tees Co. tee inside out, wash it cold with similar colors and tumble dry low. Skip bleach so the red, green and mustard inks stay bright.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in White, Natural, Pink and Heather Stone with a deep red headline and pine green punch line, and in Black, Navy, Maroon and Forest Green with a cream headline, mustard punch line and a cream outline around the dog. Graphic Tees Co. prints each tee to order in sizes S through 3XL.

Who is it a good gift for?
It is a good gift for any Frenchie owner, a partner who has watched the dog clear a plate in two seconds, or a sister whose dog steals everything off the coffee table. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order, orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess.

When should I order it for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so the Santa's Cookies? What Cookies. tee from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before Christmas. Each shirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. A misprint or damaged shirt is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
